questions.question: How many attention heads does the base Transformer use, and what is the dimension of each head?
questions.expected_response: The base Transformer uses h = 8 parallel attention heads, each with dimension d_k = d_v = d_model/h = 64.
assertions: Agent answers 8 heads with 64 dimensions per head
Agent cites the paper title and a page

questions.question: What learning rate schedule does the Transformer paper use, and how many warmup steps?
questions.expected_response: It increases the learning rate linearly for the first warmup_steps = 4000 training steps and then decreases it proportionally to the inverse square root of the step number.
assertions: Agent mentions linear warmup then inverse square root decay
Agent states 4000 warmup steps

questions.question: What BLEU score does the Transformer reach on WMT 2014 English-to-German translation?
questions.expected_response: The Transformer (big) reaches 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task.
assertions: Agent states 28.4 BLEU

questions.question: How does language model performance change with the position of relevant information in the input context?
questions.expected_response: Performance is highest when the relevant information is at the beginning or end of the input context and degrades significantly when it is in the middle, a U-shaped curve.
assertions: Agent describes a U-shaped pattern
Agent says models do worse when information is in the middle

questions.question: Which tasks does the Lost in the Middle paper use to study how models use long contexts?
questions.expected_response: It uses multi-document question answering and a synthetic key-value retrieval task.
assertions: Agent names multi-document question answering
Agent names key-value retrieval

questions.question: What are BERT's two pre-training tasks?
questions.expected_response: Masked language modeling (predicting randomly masked tokens) and next sentence prediction.
assertions: Agent names masked language modeling
Agent names next sentence prediction

questions.question: How many parameters do BERT-base and BERT-large have?
questions.expected_response: BERT-base has about 110M parameters and BERT-large has about 340M parameters.
assertions: Agent states 110M for BERT-base
Agent states 340M for BERT-large

questions.question: What does bidirectional mean in BERT compared with left-to-right language models?
questions.expected_response: BERT conditions on both left and right context in all layers during pre-training, whereas left-to-right models only see the preceding tokens.
assertions: Agent explains that BERT uses both left and right context

questions.question: How does BERT's architecture relate to the original Transformer's encoder and decoder?
questions.expected_response: BERT uses only the Transformer's encoder stack (a multi-layer bidirectional Transformer encoder) with no decoder, whereas the original Transformer has both an encoder and a decoder for sequence-to-sequence tasks.
assertions: Agent says BERT uses only the encoder
Agent contrasts this with the encoder-decoder Transformer
